functions.name: Start owned experiment engine (engine.py)
functions.behaviour: Starts the unchanged server main with the experiment adapter installed as the extra route layer; it is the engine command that the launchers start, not an interface of its own.

functions.name: Launch isolated browser experiment (g1 or g2)
functions.behaviour: Starts an owned engine for the chosen experiment mode in a per-mode session folder, writes open.html and prints a ready line; the user then closes it with the Session menu "Stop experiment" or Ctrl+C.
functions.engine_call: EngineProcess start; web page url + mode

functions.name: Open browser automatically or not (launch.py)
functions.behaviour: By default the page is opened in the system browser; the option leaves the engine running and only writes the open.html redirect and prints the ready line.

functions.name: Build and launch retained native review sample
functions.behaviour: On Windows compiles (or reuses by receipt) the native experiment host, copies the retained MPUlt runtime, re-hashes all declared inputs before engine start, starts the owned engine and runs the native host for g1 or g2 until it exits; the receipt records the run outcome.

functions.name: Build native host only
functions.behaviour: Builds the native experiment host and prints its folder and executable path without starting the engine or the host.

functions.name: Print checkout and build identities
functions.behaviour: Prints one JSON report with the source identity, number of product files, harness input hashes and, when a compiler and interpreter resolve, the build identity; writes nothing and compiles nothing. Any argument prints usage and exits 2; invalid inputs print one generic line and exit 1.

functions.name: Frozen private engine entry (Magic600Engine.exe)
functions.behaviour: Runs the packaged engine in the source layout after checking the launcher-supplied ownership environment and the bound module identities; started directly it exits with a message to open Magic600Cell.exe.

functions.name: Start the packaged application (Magic600Cell.exe)
functions.behaviour: On 64-bit Windows verifies the package manifest, starts the frozen engine on the chosen data folder (default per-user 0.4 folder), prepares the local native cache and runs the native host for g1 or g2 until it closes.

functions.name: Startup failure message box
functions.behaviour: A startup error is shown in a modal "Magic 600 Cell could not start" box on Windows (redacted text), or printed to stderr elsewhere; exit code 1.
entry_points: window Magic 600 Cell could not start

functions.name: Verify package manifest (hidden option)
functions.behaviour: Verifies every packaged file against the manifest and writes a pass report JSON without starting an engine or the native host.

functions.name: Frozen engine acceptance test (hidden option)
functions.behaviour: Starts the frozen engine on a fresh test folder, checks all 259,800 labels, the invariant proof, endgame options and an explicit Prepare preview, commit and undo, restarts it and compares the reopened labels, then writes a report JSON; the parent-eof mode exits the launcher hard right after starting the engine to test parent-pipe recovery.
functions.engine_call: frozen engine routes listed in depends_on

functions.name: Installed runtime check (hidden option)
functions.behaviour: On a fresh explicit data folder discovers the installed Managed DirectX assemblies, copies them and the retained runtime into the local cache and reports their hashes; no render is run.

functions.name: Assemble isolated 0.4 package candidate
functions.behaviour: Verifies the allowlisted sources, immutable model assets, pinned invariant report and the precompiled native host receipt, freezes the launcher and engine with the pinned PyInstaller, copies licences, writes the package manifest and optionally a zip; refuses existing output folders.
depends_on: native build receipt from cli native_launch.py --build-only

functions.name: Check the frozen package without a GUI
functions.behaviour: Runs the assembled package through manifest and payload checks, licence checks, the frozen verify, engine and parent-EOF tests, the runtime check, a generated legacy-shaped profile copy with Session, log import/export and keymap routes (MPUlt checks only with a native export), and a tamper test; writes summary.json.
functions.engine_call: frozen engine routes listed in depends_on

functions.name: Profile the paired-reply components (diagnostic)
functions.behaviour: Replays a fixed E1 fixture in an isolated session against a recorded native profile, times the command, phase, cycle, snapshot, cell, native and JSON parts for four cases, and writes profiles and report.json; refuses an existing output folder.
functions.engine_call: Workbench.command and snapshot on an isolated Session
